item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's teacher brings a sample of soil from the school garden for the class to observe.

What is this soil most likely to contain, and how was it formed?

options.A: Only sand; it formed in a few days when rainwater first touched the rocks
options.B: Sand, worms, tiny organisms, and decayed plants; it formed over thousands of years as rocks were broken down by the Sun, water, and living things
options.C: Only worms and insects; it formed in one rainy season from decayed leaves
options.D: Only large pieces of rock; it forms immediately when a rock cracks in the Sun
